# Transcript TikTok

> Transcript TikTok is a browser-based tool for turning accessible public TikTok video links into readable transcript text.

## Canonical website
- https://transcriptiktok.vercel.app/

## Main features
- Submit one public TikTok video URL at a time.
- Generate transcript text through the server-side transcript provider.
- Copy the result or export it as TXT or JSON.
- Use optional transcript actions when the required AI provider configuration is available.
- No account is required for the basic single-video workflow.

## Public pages
- Homepage: https://transcriptiktok.vercel.app/
- TikTok transcript generator: https://transcriptiktok.vercel.app/tiktok-transcript-generator.html
- TikTok video to text: https://transcriptiktok.vercel.app/tiktok-to-text.html
- TikTok transcript without login: https://transcriptiktok.vercel.app/tiktok-transcript-without-login.html
- Privacy: https://transcriptiktok.vercel.app/privacy.html
- Terms: https://transcriptiktok.vercel.app/terms.html

## Important limitations
- Only accessible public TikTok links are supported by the current transcript endpoint.
- Private, deleted, restricted, or unsupported videos may fail.
- Transcript quality and availability depend on audio quality and the upstream provider.
- Bulk processing, cloud-synced accounts, team features, billing, and guaranteed transcription are not offered.
- The Workspace stores saved items in the user's browser and is not cloud storage.
- Optional AI actions depend on server-side provider configuration and availability.
